open_issues.text: connect --branch must equal the local workspace branch (else usage error exit 2); a remote lacking the requested branch but having others is REMOTE_FOREIGN. The contract does not define a differing branch.

summary: Added remote.py (classify, connect, clone), gitutil helpers (require_version, network_env, network, fetch, ahead_behind), CLI commands connect/clone and status --fetch against origin/<branch>; tests on local bare file:// repositories; docs and changelog updated. Related tests (test_remote, test_init, test_cli) pass: 60 tests.
